faq_heading: New Westminster Condos for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

New Westminster condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in New Westminster was $579,900 in September 2026 (-7.5% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
New Westminster condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

568 condos sold in New Westminster with a median price of $580,000 (the middle half sold between $485,000 and $680,150), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $629 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median strata fee of $547 a month.

The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: New Westminster: the apartments (condos) benchmark was $579,900 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 7.5%; over three months it was little changed (-1.1%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over the last month it was little changed (+0.7%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 12.6%; over 5 years it rose 2.3%; over 10 years it rose 55.9%.

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: What did condos in New Westminster sell for?
faq.a: 568 condos sold in New Westminster between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $580,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in New Westminster?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in New Westminster sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 568 condos that sold in New Westminster went for between $485,000 and $680,150, around a median of $580,000.

faq.q: Do condos in New Westminster sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 568 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.3% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in New Westminster?
faq.a: Of the 568 sales, 567 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $547.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in New Westminster?
faq.a: The median year built was 2006 for the 568 condos sold in New Westminster.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in New Westminster usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in New Westminster had 2 bedrooms, from the 568 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which New Westminster communities sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Downtown NW (133), Quay (127), Uptown NW (125), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which New Westminster buildings sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Timber House (15), Palace Quay (11), Pier West (11), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in New Westminster?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in New Westminster was $579,900 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in New Westminster?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 7.5%. Over three months it was little changed (-1.1%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is New Westminster a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in New Westminster had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in New Westminster?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in New Westminster that match what you want.
